reviews.text: Viviane and PumpkinPups were INVALUABLE in helping us navigate a very difficult dynamic with our territorial cat and our new rescue puppy. They are passionate, empathetic, knowledgeable, professional trainers and behaviorists that truly care about you and your animal's ability to connect and communicate. I truly consider Viviane our animal/pet therapist, she helped us reframe our thinking in order to be more helpful to our pup in his training and behavioral struggles. Completely changed the game in how we think about our pup's behavior and how we can set him up for success and help him be more confident in his environment. Highly recommend Viviane, PumpkinPups, and all of their trainers!
Their weekly "Ask the Trainer" call is amazing and I learned so much. Thank you to the team for being super smart and dog-focused!

We had a great experience doing the puppy essentials class with our puppy, Cohen. Julie and Shaunacy were super knowledgeable and provided helpful skills and training exercises for us and our puppy. The hybrid class schedule works well with busy work lives and we also appreciated the other perks like free ask the trainer calls and puppy socials. Will be returning for more classes in the fall.

I wanted to share what a wonderful experience I had working with Alison and Juliana in the Puppy Essentials course. They were both extremely knowledgeable and patient, teaching me valuable skills to keep my energetic, opinionated puppy engaged. I look forward to taking more classes with them in the future to build on what we've learned.
Pumpkin Pups free weekly Ask the Trainer zoom has helped us with our anxious rescue dog so much. The trainers are so knowledgeable and we appreciate the accessibility of a free Q & A 🫶🏻

As someone who knows a little about dog training, it's very clear that they know A LOT- whenever I decribe an issue, they are able to both give me broader knowledge about dogs in general to help contextualize the behavior, and dig into the specifics of my dog. My highest complement is that they don't just prescribe plans. They have consistently given me tools to understand and think better about training my dog so I can figure out more on my own than I could before.

The team at PumpkinPups has been great! From welcoming us and our puppy to a social event, to attending their Ask the Trainer session, they have been incredibly helpful and we would recommend them to anyone!

We are so grateful to Viviane! We welcomed our adopted 2 year old dog Marcus off a Southern transport one year ago and the situation felt very dire when he arrived. He was fearful, he had resource guarding, he mouthed, he was anxious. One year later Marcus is a smiley, happy, relaxed boy. He is a beloved member of our family and gets along well with our senior dog and cat.
I credit so much of his progress to Viviane who could see past many of his fearful and reactive behaviors and advocated for him when things felt overwhelming.
The dog you bring home as a stray will not be the same dog in a year. They can and do become family members and Viviane was a steady, remarkable and caring friend and advocate for Marcus and to us the whole way. I feel so fortunate to cross paths with her. Marcus is too! Thank you, Viviane!

The best trainers in Brooklyn!

They approach working with your pets with care and know how. As soon as you meet them you'll realize you're in the right hands!
Absolutely amazing trainer and person. Always available to answer questions. Great technique, beautiful bedside manner. Highly recommend!

I only attended the "ask the trainer" zoom a few times, but it's been very helpful.  Each trainers have a different speciality and they are very knowledge.  What I appreciate the most is how they understand dog behaviors and dog psychology. Thanks for awesome advices!

I have brought both of my dogs and am so grateful for all the strategies, kindness, and care offered. The puppy socials are a terrific and rare chance to safely introduce puppies. So much gratitude for Pumpkin Pups’s work!

I've attended a few of PumpkinPups' free "ask a trainer" sessions on Saturdays. The trainers are so kind, knowledgable, and eager to help. It's nice that there are several trainers on the call to give their opinions, and they never make you feel stupid for asking a question. It's an unbelievably valuable resource, and I am very grateful for their help. I would recommend PumpkinPups to any dog parent!

I have been a professional dog trainer for over 15 years and have known Viviane for about a decade. She has always been the person I have gone to to discuss anything from business-related issues to tough behavior cases. I always come out of our conversations with new ideas or new angles from which to approach situations - I can't overstate how essential this is being in a field where we are often so isolated by the independent nature of our work.  And most significantly, I trust and respect Viviane's input as a kind and ethical person with decades of experience and knowledge which she shares so generously. I recommend Viviane without hesitation to any professional trainer looking for such an invaluable resource.

UPDATE: The owner, Viviane, reached out to me personally to check in after I left my review and to offer a private training class with her. This to me was above and beyond, and my pup and I took her up on her generosity just this past …

Learned about the free virtual Q&A thru one of the rescue orgs involved in our foster dog’s placement. These ladies were super helpful in answering our questions about reactivity on walks and leash pulling due to excitement. They are fun, knowledgeable and non-judgmental. Thank you for providing this service!

I am a canine behavior consultant in San Jose, CA. I had a consultation coming up and wanted to get a fresh set of eyes to look over this dog’s behavior history. Viviane’s assessment of how she would proceed with this case was just the …
An amazing and compassionate group of trainers. I’ve been to two ask the trainer sessions and I’ve left feeling such relief with the information and support they offer.
Norma, thank you so much for giving us a 5 star review, and for coming back to us over the years for guidance with your pups!  Viviane
